question: Where is the flame-crest said to be absorbed within the subtle body, O beautiful-faced one?
premises: The location is the bone wheel
This is addressed to the beautiful-faced one
inference: The flame-crest is absorbed in the bone wheel.
uncertainties: asthi cakre: exact anatomical referent uncertain
plain_english: There indeed, O beautiful-faced one, the flame-crest is absorbed in the wheel of bone.
